patterns.name: Quilted / padded / puffer
patterns.description: Puffy padded cells (diamond, square or puffer channels) with dashed stitch seams; lit from the top-left from the real height field, with a nylon or cotton surface.

surface.label: Surface
surface.help: nylon = ripstop grid + sheen; satin = glossy; cotton = matte weave.

patterns.name: Mesh / fishnet / tulle
patterns.description: Open net of round, twisted yarn with knots at the crossings, casting a soft shadow on the backing. Set backing to "transparent" for a see-through net. Diamond fishnet, square net or hexagonal tulle.

patterns.name: Sequins / paillettes
patterns.description: Overlapping metallic discs in staggered rows, each tilted and slightly cupped so it mirrors a studio light differently; centre hole with thread, bevelled rim, shadows from the sequin above. Several colours = mixed sequins.

seed.label: Seed

patterns.name: Cross-stitch / embroidery
patterns.description: Aida cloth with its woven blocks and holes; chart digits (1-9) are stitched as X crosses of two-strand twisted floss in palette colours, 0 = empty. Pixel-art friendly.

customChart.label: Custom chart
customChart.help: Rows of digits separated by "/" (0 = empty, max 64×64).

patterns.name: Eyelet lace (broderie anglaise)

backing.label: Backing
backing.help: What shows through the holes; "transparent" for see-through.

widths.help: Space-separated, one per band (cycled to match colours).

patterns.name: Checkerboard
patterns.description: Two-colour checks, square or diagonal (harlequin diamonds). Cell count is forced even so it tiles.

patterns.name: Polka dots & tossed motifs

patterns.name: Argyle

patterns.name: Hexagon / honeycomb

patterns.name: Ogee lattice
patterns.description: Interlocking onion shapes. Exact two-family tiling because sin²(πy) + sin²(π(y+½)) = 1. Optional inner outline and centre dot.

patterns.name: Islamic star (Hankin)
patterns.description: Hankin's polygons-in-contact: rays leave each edge midpoint at a contact angle and meet inside the tile. 4.8.8 tiling gives 8-point stars, 6.6.6 gives 6-point stars (hex rows fitted to the square tile), 4.4.4.4 gives crosses.

patterns.name: Terrazzo
patterns.description: Irregular stone chips at two scales plus fine grit on a speckled ground, with subtle per-chip polish variation.
